Case 1 (gts-83s5): a body-level bulleted list item carrying an action token round-trips as a real Docs list item, not a plain paragraph.

<LI> ACT-60: jane@example.com body-level list item action (Open)

Case 2 (gts-83s5): an ordinary body-level paragraph between the list item and the table, so the list item above is provably a distinct container rather than merely reading the same as plain text once flushed.

Some ordinary paragraph text between the list item and the table.

Case 3 (gts-83s5, dq6t AC-3): a 2x2 table with distinct actions in cell(0,0) and cell(1,1) -- the scanner must not confuse the two cells.

<TABLE rows=2 cols=2>

<CELL 0,0>

ACT-61: jane@example.com table cell plain action (Open)

<CELL 0,1>

<EMPTY>

<CELL 1,0>

<EMPTY>

<CELL 1,1>

Case 3b (gts-83s5, dq6t AC-5): a bulleted list item inside a table cell -- the LIST\_ITEM container works nested inside a CELL container the same way it does at body level.

<LI> ACT-62: jane@example.com table cell list item action (Open)

</TABLE>

<EMPTY>
